author: GrapeSmoothie
body:
Since us current staff do no have access to view the old suggestion box and that this may have been an easier way and quicker way of taking suggestions, I have decided to create a new one so us senior staff and developers can take in ideas and suggestions that you guys have. Instead of using the old google forms system, I have decided to switch it to a type form and see how it goes. 

The Suggestion Box:
Click me

Anything that you want added or changed can be submitted there.  It will be checked as often as possible

Keep in mind that the website / program we are using to receive the responses may change.

Please do not make troll responses, this is meant to help us improve.

Unfortunately, when we look for new staff members, we prioritise skill, trust and potentioal over what timezone they're in. Which is understandable, I'd rather want a group of skilled Americans than a group of WorldWide unskilled staff.

Having said that, it does suck that it works this way, in a perfect world we'd have the entire staff cover the server 24/7 in a joint effort but it's simply not as easy as it seems.
